findings.message: reviews.json is empty: no concept/base/consistency gate is recorded for orc-v1 even though identity was selected.
Clips declare direction(s) back_l, back_r, front_l; only front_r is in scope for this character so far.
10 legacy armed clips (source/equipment/, source/equipment-v2/) are preserved history: rejected v1/v2, no category/id fields, no persistent armed presentation.

canonical study clips (source/studies/{Idle,Walk}) omit canvas/groundY/ppu/loop; the onehanded display copies declare 256x256, groundY 190 and body at (64,64), while the native PNGs are 128x128. Consolidation must inherit the copy metadata.
characters/orc-v1/source/equipment-v2/militia-axe/Attack/clip.json declares contactEvent.frame=6 without timeMs; a runtime offset would have to be derived from frame durations.
characters/orc-v1/source/equipment-v2/recruit-sword/Attack/clip.json declares contactEvent.frame=6 without timeMs; a runtime offset would have to be derived from frame durations.
characters/orc-v1/source/onehanded-rescue-v3/Axe/Attack/clip.json declares contactEvent.frame=5 without timeMs; a runtime offset would have to be derived from frame durations.
characters/orc-v1/source/onehanded-rescue-v3/Sword/Attack/clip.json declares contactEvent.frame=5 without timeMs; a runtime offset would have to be derived from frame durations.
Walk approval is "PENDING_CREATOR_GREEN_WALK"; treat it as current-but-unapproved for green, not as an approved gate.

limitations: Technical audit only: presence, hashes, canvas, durations and declared metadata. It does not judge artistic quality, weight, grip or tactical readability.
No Unity/PlayMode verification: the runtime does not consume these overlays yet.
Coverage is scoped to front_r, the only view produced for this character at the baseline.
